scoring_justification: Cannot re-run heavy EMC simulation in lightweight verifier; scoring compares reported mobility values and ratio to paper-reported numbers with tolerances, plus self-consistency check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for hole mobility in wurtzite InN extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and body: phonon-limited mobility ~220, realistic 20–70, ratio implied.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from paper statements with tolerance ranges that absorb simulation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own main numerical claims, traceable to paragraphs and Figure 3.

outputs.description: Low-field hole mobility for the two conditions: (a) phonon-limited, (b) with realistic dislocation density and residual donor concentration. The ratio is realistic_mobility / phonon_limited_mobility.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each mobility and the ratio to hidden reference values (derived from the paper) with appropriate tolerances. Agent must implement the EMC simulation from scratch; no pre-existing code is provided.
